hadiths.text: I have been sent only to perfect the noble qualities of character.
benefits: The Prophet's (PBUH) mission was to perfect moral character
Emphasizes the importance of adopting good character
Character is a fundamental pillar of faith
Serves as a means to establish better relationships in society

hadiths.text: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other Muslims are safe, and a Muhajir (emigrant) is the one who abandons what Allah has forbidden.
benefits: Defines the true characteristics of a Muslim
Teaches to protect others from one's tongue and hands
Makes abandoning evil (Hijrat) part of faith
Serves as a means of social peace and security

hadiths.text: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed, it will erase it, and treat people with good character.
benefits: Taqua (fear of Allah) is the fundamental virtue
Good deeds expiate sins, so importance of righteous actions
Good deeds erase sins, which is a source of hope
Good conduct with people is part of religion

hadiths.text: Indeed, the believer, through his good character, attains the rank of the one who fasts during the day and stands in prayer at night.
benefits: Excellent character has extremely high virtue
Through good character, one can attain the status of worshippers
Character has been declared superior to worship
Introduces morality along with the virtues of fasting and Tahajjud prayer
